scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npx prisma generate && PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true npm run build
scripts.start: cd backend && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node dist/index.js
